spiral: Pre-registered: at T1024 bs32 lr.003, residual d1 w96 GELU LN spiral, AdamW has lower mean CE than Adam at wd.001 and .01 for both beta2 .95 and .999; wd0 twins agree. Absolute differences may be small; no claim of large practical effect at near-zero CE.
sgd: Pre-registered: deep d3 w256 plain SiLU zero-LN MSE with default init: increasing SGD lr .003 to .03 at momentum .9 improves CE/MSE mean; residual may improve learning but need not beat adaptive twins. Near-frozen is not testable from endpoints alone.
tabular: Pre-registered: at matched lr/budget in the same tabular set, shallow/deep direction will vary by rule/exposure; a universal Delta=.1 boundary will not be assumed.
